company_name: Institute of Science Tokyo, Shigeki Saito Laboratory
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company develops specialized equipment for handling semiconductor wafers, which is critical for manufacturing processes.
summary: The Institute of Science Tokyo, Shigeki Saito Laboratory specializes in advanced equipment for the semiconductor industry, particularly focusing on innovative solutions for wafer handling. Their Variable Curvature Electrostatic Chuck (A-VCESC) enhances the transport and mounting of power semiconductor wafers and interposers, significantly improving yield and equipment performance.
capabilities: Transport and mounting solutions for warped substrates
